text: The sources do not contradict each other. Hansen's data shows a tree-cover loss of 67.7 ha in 2020, but this loss occurred before the 2020-12-31 baseline. The JRC data, which is a reference map for 2020, shows no forest in the asset, indicating that the tree-cover loss had already occurred by the time the JRC data was collected. Therefore, both sources agree that there was no forest in the asset in 2020.
